STATEMENT OF FINANCIAL POSITION 
Assets Liabilities & Equity 
As of September 30, 2025
Assets: 
•Total assets grew 4.4% to 4,566.14M baht (+190.46 M baht)
•Inventory decreased 87.82M baht due to business cycle and 
seasonal factors
•Right-of-use assets increased 117.30M baht and property, plant & 
equipment rose 94.90M baht from branch expansion and head office 
relocation
Liabilities:
•Total liabilities grew 1.3% to 2,080.98M baht (+26.81M baht)
•Trade payables decreased 60.51M baht from inventory preparations 
completed in late 2024
•Lease liabilities increased 130.38M baht, aligned with right -of-use 
assets from branch expansion and head office relocation
Equity
•Total shareholders' equity had a value of 2,485.16M baht, an increase 
of 163.65M baht or 7.0% from the end of 2024, in line with the 
company's operating results .Unit: Million Baht
